delivery: Same-origin gzip stream reconstruction; compiled LZ4 AssetBundles requested only when needed.
preservation: Only compiled output is packaged. No source PNG/WAV files, metadata, Unity project, private packs or credentials are published.

packagingInputs.controlCaption: Player-selected aiming and conditional fire; no runtime JavaScript altered.

warmWebGLImportPolicy.scope: Exact original Main PNG/meta/GUID and full Warm metadata reconstruction changing only four known WebGL fields. Actual serialized Texture2D fields remain uninspected without resident TypeTrees.

residentPickupAudio.scope: Four actual resident clip object fields and confined compiled audio payload slices; original OGG/GUID/import identity is separate. No natural audibility, phone execution or original/transcoded byte equivalence.

launcher.caption: Portrait play. Move with the left control, drag on the right to aim, and tap DASH to dodge. Auto-fire follows your chosen aim only when an enemy is visible, in range, and in a clear line.

actualReleasePrerequisites.scope: Actual fullR14 native and CampaignR10 only; Web/mobile/device/listening/final-doc acceptance are separate.
